scope: DM unread counts survive scans: live bumps are added, not replaced by the stored count.
files_to_modify: app/src/lib/unreadStore.ts (reconcileInit additive mode for the DM slice; initDirectMessageCounts clears confirm-recount counted ids; module comment)

behavior.startup_scan: count = max(pre-scan, stored) + live DMs during the scan, per scanned peer
behavior.other_keys: a DM scan never rewrites a peer outside its key list
behavior.unchanged: group, join-request and pending-contact slices keep the re-read

tests: Unit: startup scan + live DM; confirm recount + other peer's live DM; scan between recounts
